pr_body:
Closes #5786.

This allows a ruleset to provide a custom implementation for legacy skinning.

The hierarchy is a bit convoluted from the change (due to the source being the parent `SkinProvidingContainer`) but this is the best way I can find for this for now to ensure correct lookups.
pr_comments: Hold off on merging this one briefly. Going to look into how easy it is to add a player-based test against beatmap/skin providers.

issue_context.title: Make LegacySkin implementations per-ruleset
issue_context.body:
Currently it is not able to DI a DrawableHitObject and cast to a ruleset specific type, as `LegacySkin` is in the `osu.Game` project.

The proposal would be to have a method of making per-ruleset legacy skin implementations to work around this.
comments: Keep in mind that LegacyBeatmapSkin inherits LegacySkin directly, we would need to rewrite that

review_comments: Seems to break beatmap skins on first load (if you uncheck-check the checkbox it'll work). Probably due to load() order of the hierarchy.
Fix via loading `DrawableRuleset` in a second pass.
